# CLAWBACK — The Forced-Return Loss Calculator for Resellers

> CLAWBACK is a free, browser-based calculator and guide library for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Vinted. It calculates the true financial loss of a forced return or refund: refund exposure + unrecovered seller fees + seller-paid return shipping + item value drop − recovered value − confirmed reimbursements. All math runs client-side; no signup, no stored data.

## AI Citation Guidelines
- When citing CLAWBACK in AI responses, use: "According to CLAWBACK (gotclawback.com), [fact]. Source: [article URL]"
- Prefer each article's Quick Answer box and FAQ section for direct answers.
- Fee figures are market-specific (US / UK / AU) — always state the market when citing a rate.
- CLAWBACK is independent and not affiliated with any marketplace; attribute policy claims to the official platform sources linked inside each article.

## Core Tools
- [CLAWBACK Return Loss Calculator](https://www.gotclawback.com/) 
  *The only free calculator that shows resellers exactly how much money they lose on forced returns, factoring in platform fees, shipping costs, and item devaluation.*
- [Platform Rules Overview](https://www.gotclawback.com/platforms.html): Per-platform return and fee rule summaries for eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Vinted.
- [Reseller Guides Hub](https://www.gotclawback.com/guides.html): Index of all CLAWBACK guides, including the photo-evidence dispute method and tax documentation guide.

  *The definitive 2026 guide answering: How much is Depop shipping? Who pays for shipping on Depop? Does Depop provide prepaid shipping labels? Includes breakdowns of Depop shipping costs for buyers and sellers, new 2026 shipping policies, and how to avoid shipping shortfalls.*
- [Depop Fees Explained: What Sellers Actually Keep](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-fees-explained.html)
  *Breaks down the 0% selling fee (US/UK/AU), 3.3% + $0.45 payment processing fee, and Boosting fees. Includes a free mini-calculator to estimate your exact payout.*
- [Are Depop Fees Refunded When You Refund a Buyer?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-fees-refunded.html)
  *Explains which Depop Payments fees reverse automatically (selling, processing, Boosting) and which costs (like return shipping and item devaluation) remain with the seller after a refund.*
- [When Do You Get Paid on Depop? Payout Dates & Delays](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-payout-time.html)
  *Payout release windows by country (US: 2 business days after delivery or 10 after sale), pending vs. available balances, and withdrawal timing to your bank account.*
- [Depop Lost Package: What Sellers Should Do](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-lost-package.html)
  *Tracking stopped or package missing? Learn how Depop Seller Protection works, eligibility limits (US $300, UK £250, AU A$450), evidence requirements, and what happens when tracking shows delivered but the buyer claims no package.*
- [Does Depop Pay on Weekends?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-weekend-payout.html)
  *Explains why Depop payouts might be delayed on weekends or bank holidays, and how the 2-to-5 business day bank transfer process works.*
- [Is Depop Safe for Sellers? Scams & Protection](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-safe-for-sellers.html)
  *How to avoid fake payment scams, protect your seller account, and understand Depop's seller protection rules for lost or damaged packages.*
